plot: On the stormy night before his first crossing-guard shift, Turbo can't sleep and zooms around the wet streets pretending to train; night-shift tow truck Grumpy takes him on a quiet ride, baker van Benny shows him how to drive smoothly on wet roads, and they practise puddles all night until the splash becomes a splish; an hour before sunrise Turbo admits he is scared, and Grumpy finally takes down the old paper always hanging in his cab: a note Mrs. Maple wrote him on his own scared first night, 'Slow is not scared. Slow is careful'; he gives it to Turbo, who crosses the biggest puddle with no splash at dawn; lesson: brave means you go anyway, slowly; then Pip drives past alone, sad that nobody remembered her birthday.

script.title: Turbo Can't Sleep!

set.place: Wheelburg main street and Grumpy's night-shift corner, stormy night until dawn

script.description: The night before his first day as crossing guard, Turbo can't sleep. Inspector Bolt #15

beats.say: Slow, slow, slow! Why is slow so hard? Whoa, puddle!
Turbo? It's midnight. Why are you zooming around in the rain?
I'm not zooming. I'm... training. Very normal training.
It was the night of the big storm.
Rain tapped on every roof in Wheelburg. Tap, tap, tap.
Tomorrow at seven, Turbo would start his first day as crossing guard.
Hmph. I drive the night shift. Every night.
And I know nervous when I see it.
Me? Nervous? Ha! I'm Turbo! I'm never nervous!
His bumper was shaking. Just a little. Okay, a lot.
What's that paper in your window, Grumpy?
Nothing. Old paper. None of your business.
Grumpy's cab light was always on.
And that old paper always hung in the window.
Fine. Watch this. I'll drive through that puddle super slow.
Turbo tried. He really tried. But his wheels had other plans.
I'm wet. I'm always wet at night. But now I'm wetter.
Sorry! See? Slow is impossible for me!
Then a sleepy voice came from the bus garage.
Mmm... five more minutes... the wheels on the bus...
Shh! Bertha's sleep-singing again. Don't wake her up.
She sings every night. Same song. Wrong words. Every time.
Come with me. I'll show you something. Quietly.
Grumpy rolled slowly down the dark, wet street. Turbo followed.
At the corner, a warm orange van was unloading something.
Evening, Grumpy! Or is it morning? Fresh bread for the café!
You work at two in the morning? In the rain?
Every night. Bread doesn't wait for good weather.
The town wakes up hungry. Somebody has to be ready.
Watch how Benny drives on wet roads.
Benny turned the corner. Slow. Smooth. Not one splash.
How do you do that? My tires go wheee every time.
Easy on the pedal. Eyes far ahead. And breathe out.
If I rush, the bread falls. If you rush, the kids fall.
Oh. When you say it like that... it's not about me.
Here. Warm bread for the night crew. Good luck tomorrow, guard.
Benny honked softly and drove off into the rain.
Five hours, Grumpy! What if I splash a kid?
What if I'm late on my very first day?
What if everybody laughs and says Turbo can only zoom?
Then you try again. Come on. Puddle practice.
So they practised. Puddle after puddle. All night long.
Easy on the pedal.
Easy on the pedal. Eyes far ahead. Breathe out.
Splash. Then a smaller splash. Then just a little splish.
Did you see that? Only a splish! I did a splish!
I saw. Hmph. Not bad, kid. Not bad at all.
Lights came on in the house next door. Somebody woke up.
Turbo? Grumpy? It's four in the morning. Is everything all right?
Bolt! I'm practising being slow. It's the hardest thing ever.
Then you are already braver than most. Carry on. Quietly, please.
Bolt went back to bed. And Turbo got very quiet again.
Grumpy, can I tell you a secret? I'm scared. Really scared.

beats.text: THE SUN RISES IN ONE HOUR!

beats.say: In one hour I'm the guard. And I still feel wobbly inside.
Grumpy didn't say anything. He just rolled back to his cab.
And for the first time, he took down the old paper.
My first night shift, I was so scared, I towed nothing.
I hid behind the bakery. Shaking. Till the sun came up.
You? Scared? But you're Grumpy! You aren't scared of anything!
Everybody is scared of something. Even tow trucks.
Then an old green crossing guard found me. And wrote this.
An old green crossing guard? Wait. Mrs. Maple?
Read it.

beats.text: SLOW IS NOT SCARED. SLOW IS CAREFUL.

beats.say: Slow is not scared. Slow is careful.
I kept it twenty years. Now it's yours. Don't get it wet.
Grumpy, this is the nicest thing anyone ever gave me.
Hmph. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.
The rain stopped. The sky turned pink. And it was almost seven.
Turbo rolled to the school crossing. Slowly. Carefully.
Right through the biggest puddle in Wheelburg.
No splash! Not even a splish! Grumpy, I did it!
Never doubted you. Okay. I doubted you a little.
Mmm... is it morning? Why is everyone so happy?
Even brave cars get scared. Brave means you go anyway. Slowly.
Then a tiny pink car drove past. All alone.
Today is my birthday... and nobody said a single word.
Oh no. Pip's birthday! Grumpy... did we forget?
